```{r}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)
```

## Import Rds from results of above

```{r}
long_data <- readRDS(here("Woods_Creek_data","long_data_clean.Rds"))
data_clean <- readRDS(here("Woods_Creek_data","data_clean_noNA.Rds"))
```

```{r}
 geom_histogram()+ facet_grid(~YEAR,
```

```{r}
#summarizing mean live diameter over time by treatment
mean_DIA_df <- long_data %>%   
  group_by(TRT, YEAR_F, .drop = FALSE) %>%  
  summarise(live_DIA_median=median(live_DIA, na.rm = TRUE),live_DIA_mean=mean(live_DIA, na.rm = TRUE), live_DIA_se=sd(live_DIA, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(n()), n_samples = n())%>% ungroup()
glimpse(mean_DIA_df)
#converting factor year back to numeric and restoring values for plotting
mean_DIA_df$YEAR<-as.numeric(mean_DIA_df$YEAR_F)
mean_DIA_df$YEAR[mean_DIA_df$YEAR==1]<-1990
mean_DIA_df$YEAR[mean_DIA_df$YEAR==2]<-1995
mean_DIA_df$YEAR[mean_DIA_df$YEAR==3]<-2000
mean_DIA_df$YEAR[mean_DIA_df$YEAR==4]<-2009
mean_DIA_df$YEAR[mean_DIA_df$YEAR==5]<-2020
#add names to treatments

#plotting mean live diameter
ggplot(data = mean_DIA_df, # add the data
       aes(x = YEAR,  #set x, y coordinates
           y = live_DIA_mean,
           color = TRT)) +    # color by treatment
  geom_point(size = 3) + # set size of the dots
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= (live_DIA_mean - live_DIA_se), ymax= (live_DIA_mean + live_DIA_se)))

#plotting median live diameter
ggplot(data = mean_DIA_df, # add the data
       aes(x = YEAR,  #set x, y coordinates
           y = live_DIA_median,
           color = TRT)) +    # color by treatment
  geom_point(size = 3) # set size of the dots

ggplot(data = mean_DIA_df, # add the data
       aes(x = live_DIA_mean,  #set x, y coordinates
           y = live_DIA_median,
           color = TRT)) +    # color by treatment
  geom_point(size = 3) # set size of the dots  
```

```{r}
#summarizing total live basal area over time by treatment
sum_BA_df <- long_data %>%   
  group_by(TMT, YEAR_F, .drop = FALSE) %>%  
  summarise(sum_live_BA=sum(live_BA, na.rm = TRUE), cells = n())%>%ungroup()
#converting factor year back to numeric and restoring values for plotting
sum_BA_df$YEAR<-as.numeric(sum_BA_df$YEAR_F)
sum_BA_df$YEAR[sum_BA_df$YEAR==1]<-1990
sum_BA_df$YEAR[sum_BA_df$YEAR==2]<-1995
sum_BA_df$YEAR[sum_BA_df$YEAR==3]<-2000
sum_BA_df$YEAR[sum_BA_df$YEAR==4]<-2009
sum_BA_df$YEAR[sum_BA_df$YEAR==5]<-2020
glimpse(sum_BA_df)
#counting living trees (those with a numeric value for live basal area)
BA_NA<-long_data %>% group_by(TMT, YEAR_F, .drop = FALSE) %>% count(is.na(live_BA))
BA_NA_FALSE<-BA_NA[which(BA_NA$`is.na(live_BA)` ==FALSE),c(1,2,4)]
names(BA_NA_FALSE)<-c("TMT","YEAR_F","n_live_trees")
glimpse(BA_NA_FALSE)
sum_BA_df$n_live_trees<-BA_NA_FALSE$n_live_trees
sum_BA_df
#split by species
sum_BA_SP_df <- long_data %>%   
  group_by(TMT, YEAR_F, species_gen, .drop = FALSE) %>%  
  summarise(sum_live_BA=sum(live_BA, na.rm = TRUE), cells = n())%>%ungroup()
#converting factor year back to numeric and restoring values for plotting
sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR<-as.numeric(sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR_F)
sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR[sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR==1]<-1990
sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR[sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR==2]<-1995
sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR[sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR==3]<-2000
sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR[sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR==4]<-2009
sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR[sum_BA_SP_df$YEAR==5]<-2020
glimpse(sum_BA_SP_df)
BA_NA_SP<-long_data %>% group_by(TMT, YEAR_F, species_gen, .drop = FALSE) %>% count(is.na(live_BA))
BA_NA_SP_FALSE<-BA_NA_SP[which(BA_NA_SP$`is.na(live_BA)` ==FALSE),]
names(BA_NA_SP_FALSE)<-c("TMT","YEAR_F","species_gen","logic", "n_live_trees")
glimpse(BA_NA_SP_FALSE)
sum_BA_SP_df$n_live_trees<-BA_NA_SP_FALSE$n_live_trees
sum_BA_SP_df
#plot total basal area
ggplot(data = sum_BA_df, # add the data
       aes(x = YEAR, y = sum_live_BA, color = TMT)) +
  geom_point(size = 3)
#plot tree count
ggplot(data = sum_BA_df, # add the data
       aes(x = YEAR, y = n_live_trees, color = TMT)) +
  geom_point(size = 3)
#proportion living total
prop_living<-long_data %>% group_by(TMT, YEAR_F, alive, .drop = FALSE) %>% summarise(count=n())
```

```{r}
#plot sum of BA binned by tree size at each time point (Similar to apiary, just calc BA from live DBH)


#plot mortality binned by tree size at each time point (like in Apiary)
#make variable containing total counts of trees with diameters
median_dbh_Alive<-subset(long_data, alive=="Alive") %>% 
  group_by(YEAR, TRT, alive) %>% 
  summarise(Median=round(median(DIA, na.rm=TRUE)), N=n())
median_dbh_Dead<-subset(long_data, alive=="Dead") %>% 
  group_by(YEAR, TRT, alive) %>% 
  summarise(Median=round(median(DIA, na.rm=TRUE)), N=n())
#input<- subset(lessA1A3, (Tree_status=="Alive"|Tree_status=="Dead")& !is.na(DBH_mm_nom))
pall<- subset(long_data, (alive=="Alive"|alive=="Dead")& !is.na(DIA)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(DIA,fill=alive))+
  geom_histogram(position="identity", alpha=0.65, binwidth =5)+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(begin = 0.33, end = 0.99)+
  labs(title= "Size distrubtion of trees by Year and Treatment",x="DBH (cm)",y= "Trees") +
  geom_label(data = median_dbh_Alive,aes(x=Median+50,y=100,label=paste0("Sum: \n",N,"\n Median: \n",Median,"cm"), alpha=0.05),  show.legend = FALSE, label.size = 0)+
  geom_label(data = median_dbh_Dead,aes(x=25,y=100, label=paste0("Sum: \n",N,"\n Median: \n",Median,"cm"), fontface='italic', alpha=0.05), show.legend = FALSE, label.size = 0)+ 
  geom_vline(data=median_dbh_Dead,aes(xintercept=Median), linetype=2, alpha=0.5)+
  geom_vline(data=median_dbh_Alive,aes(xintercept=Median), alpha=0.5)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
  facet_grid(rows=vars(YEAR),vars(TRT), labeller = label_both)+
  #scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,20,40,60,80,100),limits=c(0,100))+
  xlim(0,200)+ylim(0,150)+
  theme_bw()
pall
```

## Generating plot summary and stand summary datasets

```{r}
#creating plot level DF for all species
plot_level_df<-long_data %>% group_by(Plot_ID_TBP, YEAR_F, species_gen, COND_CUM) %>% summarise(count = n(), live_BA = sum(live_BA, na.rm=TRUE), mean_live_DIA= mean(live_DIA, na.rm=TRUE))
#adding the separate TMT, BLOCK, and PLOT columns
plot_level_df<-plot_level_df %>% separate(Plot_ID_TBP, c("TMT","BLOCK","PLOT"),"_",remove = FALSE)
plot_level_df$TMT<-as.factor(plot_level_df$TMT)
plot_level_df$BLOCK<-as.factor(plot_level_df$BLOCK)
plot_level_df$PLOT<-as.factor(plot_level_df$PLOT)
glimpse(plot_level_df)
#creating unique stand ID factor varaible of format TRT_BLOCK
plot_level_df$Stand_ID_TB<-as.factor(paste(plot_level_df$TMT,plot_level_df$BLOCK, sep = "_"))
```

```{r}
stand_level_df<- plot_level_df %>% group_by(Stand_ID_TB, YEAR_F, species_gen, COND_CUM, .drop = FALSE)%>% summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm=TRUE), live_BA = sum(live_BA, na.rm=TRUE))
glimpse(stand_level_df)
#adding the separate TMT, and BLOCK columns
stand_level_df<-stand_level_df %>% separate(Stand_ID_TB, c("TMT","BLOCK"),"_",remove = FALSE)
stand_level_df$TMT<-as.factor(stand_level_df$TMT)
stand_level_df$BLOCK<-as.factor(stand_level_df$BLOCK)
glimpse(stand_level_df)
#write_rds(data_clean, "C:/Users/shawn/Desktop/data_clean.Rds")

write_rds(plot_level_df,"plot_level_df.Rds")
write_rds(stand_level_df,"stand_level_df.Rds")
```
